# AC Server Manager 0.5.1 Preview

## Changes

- Save configuration directly without a confirmation dialog. Report success in the status bar and validation notices in the Validation tab. Reload after a successful write; preserve the draft when a write fails. Keep backups and protection against external configuration edits.
- Right-click a server to open a themed Delete server menu. The action targets the clicked server without discarding another server's draft. Running servers remain protected; deletion uses the Windows Recycle Bin and asks for confirmation.
- Match Delete server button spacing to the adjacent action buttons.
- Unify orange interface accents, including buttons, scrollbar handles and the logo slash, under #FF5D43. Keep the version badge's separate tint.
- Retain compact 34-pixel search fields, restore the orange focus border and align the hint with the actual WPF text/caret position in the catalog and creation wizard.

## Download and run

Extract **ACServerManager-0.5.1-preview-win-x64.zip** completely into a writable folder and run **AssettoServerManager.exe**. The Windows x64 package includes .NET; keep the other files alongside the EXE. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the archive checksum.

Choose your servers folder on first launch; the application remembers it. Assetto Corsa is detected through Steam, with manual folder selection available. Bring your own game content and Content Manager. Saving does not restart a running server.

Application: MIT; bundled runtime notices are in `licenses/`.
